Delhi Police has denied permission for the proposed protest by the CJP at Jantar Mantar
tomorrow. Addressing the media in New Delhi this morning, Delhi Police Joint Commissioner
and Nupur Prasad said applications seeking permission to hold protests or other programs
at Jantar Mantar must be submitted at least 10 days in advance. Ms Prasad noted that
the CJP had previously been granted permission to hold a protest at the venue but failed to
comply with the prescribed guidelines and the undertakings given by the party. Joint
Commissioner said the decision to deny permission was taken in view of the party's previous
failure to adhere to Delhi Police guidelines and its own undertakings as well as the prevailing
law and order situation, public safety and traffic regulations in the new Delhi area.
was given a very short span of time, whereas, as per the prescribed guideline, the intimation
has to be received 10 days prior to the protest which is planned.
Ms Prasad further stated that prohibitory orders under section 163 of the Bharati and
Agraksa Raksha Sanhita are currently in force in the area, imposing necessary restrictions
to maintain public safety and law and order.
The Joint Commissioner warned that the Delhi Police would take appropriate legal action
against anyone found violating the law.
Delhi Police has proposed closure of the entry and exit gates of 57 metro stations from 9pm
today in view of the proposed protest at Jantar Mandir in New Delhi tomorrow.
The police sent this proposal to the managing director of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation
DMRC.
The police have also asked DMRC to reduce the frequency of metro trains, citing the
likelihood of unruly crowd movement towards sensitive locations in the national capital.
The identified metro stations include Rajiv Chowk, Lok Kalyanmarg, Central Secretary at
Janpat, Patel Chowk, New Delhi, Sevati Earth, Mandi House and Janpat.
Delhi PDE said the restrictions have been proposed from today, which may continue
till tomorrow or till the situation gets normalized.
All mail-and-express trains departing from their source stations after 2 p.m. today
and schedule to arrive at New Delhi and Hazrat Nizamuddin railway stations between 4 a.m.
and 2 p.m. tomorrow will be cancelled at source. The railway's ministry said this
decision has been taken in view of the anticipated severe road traffic congestion in areas around
both the railway stations tomorrow. Five thousand passengers missed their trains
yesterday after access roads to New Delhi railway station were blocked and made traffic
restrictions in central Delhi during the opposition's protest. The disruption affected passengers'
travel plans, resulting in financial losses and missed onward connections. Among those
affected were 56 students from IIT Jodhpur, who missed the Dibrooghar Rajthani Express
schedule to depart at 4pm. According to reports, opposition MPs and Congress workers gathered
at Rajgharat for the protest. Following a luncheon hosted by Congress President Malikarjun
at a restaurant in Cannot Place. The traffic restrictions imposed in the area caused severe
inconvenience to thousands of passengers attempting to reach the railway station. People who had
nothing to do with the protest had to suffer inconvenience.
The Government has advised social media intermediaries to exercise enhanced diligence in respect
of information being disseminated on their platforms and which has the potential to
to adversely affect public order or social tranquility.
The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology has said certain information, including
false, misleading, manipulated or out-of-contest, content is being circulated through various
social media platforms in relation to ongoing public events and developments.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will participate in the Valedictory Session of Departmental
summit on women and child development in New Delhi this evening. The two-day departmental
summit, which began yesterday, is witnessing participation of political leadership and
officials dealing with the women and child development sector from all states. More
from our correspondent.
It is second in the series of departmental summits envisioned by the Prime Minister
to strengthen cooperative federalism, foster collective ownership of national priorities
activities and accelerate outcomes through closer center-state collaboration.
The summit is focusing on four key themes, including nutrition, early education, child
protection, women's safety, and empowerment.
The departmental summit model is bringing together stakeholders from the union and
state governments to deliberate on sectoral priorities, share good practices, address
implementation challenges, and agree on time-bound actions for improved governance and service
delivery with Priya, Saklein Akhtar, Aakashwani News, Delhi.
Union Communications Minister Jyothiraditya Sindhya has said India's telecom and digital
sectors have witnessed remarkable transformation over the past decade and has emerged on the
global stage. Addressing a press conference at the India Mobile Congress in New Delhi,
Mr. Sindhya said, India has also become the fifth country in the world to develop
of its own indigenous 4G stack, he said the cost of one gigabyte of data has declined
from 268 rupees to less than 8 rupees. Mr. Singhya said India aims to double its 5G
user base from 550 million to 1 billion by 2030.
The Supreme Court has directed the center, states and union territories to integrate
four digital platforms related to motor accident claims within four weeks to curb
fraudulent insurance claims and speed up compensation settlements. The platforms
include IIDAR, VAHAN, SARATI and the Insurance Information Bureau. The
integration will enable seamless sharing of accident reports, vehicle
and insurance records and previous claim histories. It will also cover
hit-and-run cases and the PM Rahat scheme. The court directed all states to upload relevant
data to the E-DAR portal without delay, noting that only a few states had begun doing so.
This is Aakashwani giving you the news.

Welcome back to the midday news.
Counting of votes for the Tantabadi Assembly constituency by election in Puducherry has
been completed.
All India NR Congress candidate Ashok Anand has secured a comfortable victory with a margin
of 8,482 votes in the seat vacated by puthicherry chief minister N. Rangasamy, Ashok Anand secured
13,358 votes, while his nearest rival international congress candidate, even Aikam, polled 4,876
votes.
In Tamil Nadu assembly by elections at Maduranta Kamendharapuram, the ruling TVK has taken
the lead in both the constituencies, the leading contestants, Maragatama Kumaraveel
and Satya Bama had resigned from the AIADMK and post poll. They joined the ruling TVK party.
The counting is underway for by-elections to other four assembly constituencies
in Tamil Nadu and West Bengal, and one Lok Sabha seat in Assam is underway.
The five assembly seats were polling was held on Tuesday,
Armaduranthakam and Dharapuram in Tamil Nadu,
Tattanchavadi in Puducherry and Rajinagar and Nandigram in West Bengal.
The lone loks of Haseed that went to polls is Nagaon in Assam.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined
by the mantra of Jan Seva, Siddesh, Seva and a relentless commitment that continues.
Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working
towards achieving the goal of a vikasidh Bharat by 2047.
Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives.
Today in our special series, we bring you how the Bete Bachao Bete Parhao campaign in 2015
to prevent female feticide, ensure the safety and education of the girl child
and promote equal opportunities for girls.
Here is a report by our correspondent.
The Bete Bachao Bete Parhao campaign was launched to address challenges such as
female-ferticide, gender discrimination, and disparities in girls' education.
The campaign focuses on the survival, safety, education, and overall development of the girls.
It also promotes school-enrollment, continuation of education, safe motherhood, and menstrual
hygiene, while encouraging positive changes in social attitudes towards girl-child.
According to available figures, the number of girls per thousand boys at birth increased
from 9.18 in 2014-15 to 9.25 in 2023-24. During the same period, the gross enrollment ratio
of girls at the secondary level rose from 75.51% to 80.2%. Institutional deliveries also increased
from 61% to nearly 98%. Rajasthan-2 has recorded significant progress with the sex
Roshu at birth improving from 929 to 941 during last decade.
The celebration of the birth of daughters in the state has further strengthened the message
that a daughter is not a burden but a source of strength for the family and society.
Over the past 10 years, Beti Bachao Beti Prahav has grown beyond a government scheme
into a powerful social movement promoting the dignity, education and equal opportunities
authorities of the girl child, with Jitendra Duvedi, Saleha Ghazi, Akash Mani News, Jaipur.
The external affairs ministry has said that U.S. Department of Labor's decision concerning
the Permanent Labor Certification Perm program for certain companies is distinct from the
H1B visa program.
The ministry in a statement said, the suspension of perm applications does not by itself
affect the validity of existing H1B visas or the status of H1B visa holders and their
dependents. It added that though there could be some impact on the permanent residency
or green card process, a eligible employee is of the affected companies.
Earlier, the Trump administration has announced a suspension of a key employment-based green
card process for eight major technology and outsourcing companies, including Indian
Indian firms Infosys, DCS, Wipro and HCL.
The action also covers Cognizant, Cape Germany, Microsoft and Adobe.
In cricket, India will take on the West Indies in the second of the five-match D-20 international
series in Rachi today.
The match is scheduled to begin at 7 p.m. Indian time.
India lead the series one-nail after winning the opening match, with Skipper, Shreyasayar
century powering the hosts to victory.
The Intermetrological Department, IMD, focused heavy rainfall accompanied by thunderstorms,
lightning and gusty winds over Kerala, Mahi, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala until tomorrow.
Heavy rainfall is also likely to prevail, though South interior Karnataka and Uttarakhand
during the day.
IMD said Lakshadweep, Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, East Madhya Pradesh, Jharkhand, Odisha,
West Bengal and Sikkim are also expected to witness thunderstorms, lightning and
gusty winds today.

And with that, we end the midday news.
